_comment: Keys to ADD to the config Strata-HotRod's setup.sh wrote (e.g. strata-iq3_s.json): top-level server settings, next to its own exe/args/env. aliases lets the kit's gateway send the model name 'home'; reasoning_effort none makes requests without an effort answer at once (Home Assistant, mail). idle_unload_s optionally frees the remote card's VRAM after N idle seconds. For 262K context, set --max-context 262144 in its "args" (HotRod README). Delete this _comment key.
